text:
Rae (Product): quick post-all-hands follow-up: leadership asked for a single canonical timeline + "go/no-go" acceptance checklist for API v2, Console GA, and Optimize suggestions. can we lock down targets this week for external comms?

Sophie (CEO): we can publish target windows but flag them as provisional. want a one-pager that lists targets + clear acceptance gates.

Igor (Eng): API v2 status: code frozen, awaiting one last perf kernel and security audit. realistic rollout is: 10d canary -> 7d ramp -> opt-in -> GA. Main risk: kernel perf.

Min (Platform): Console rollout constraint: tenant migration tooling and RBAC parity. plan: internal migration rehearsal late-Aug, invited beta early-Sept, GA mid-Oct. Ops requires a rollback-tested migration runbook.

Jae (DevEx): partners ask for a matrix (beta vs GA) and exact feature-flag names. Product should publish that with SDK snippets.

Rae (Product): proposed targets (draft):
```
API v2: canary ~ 2026-08-09, GA target ~ 2026-09-18
Console: invited beta ~ 2026-09-12, GA target ~ 2026-10-14
Optimize (cost hints): opt-in preview ~ 2026-09-03, public beta ~ 2026-09-26
```

Igor (Eng): acceptance gates for API v2: security audit passed, P99 <= 1.25x baseline, no memory growth after 72h soak, perf regression <3% on token cost. I'll post checklist in the eng board.

Min (Platform): Console gates: dry-run on 3 tenants, rollback script validated, migration runbook < 30m per tenant, and 48h post-migration monitoring green.

Jae (DevEx): add partner criteria: SDK samples, feature-flag list, migration examples, and a short video demo. I'll draft the partner FAQ.

Rae (Product): action items: 1) Rae -> publish one-pager + feature matrix (owner); 2) Igor -> perf/security checklist; 3) Min -> schedule dry-runs + runbook; 4) Jae -> partner FAQ + demo. Will post links in this thread by Friday EOD.

ci-bot: scheduled: canary-reserve job queued for 2026-08-04 10:00 UTC.

Sophie (CEO): decision: publish targets with "target / provisional" label, and commit to a canary status update ~10 days after canary start. keep this thread as the single partner-facing source. keep replies short. :white_check_mark:
